title: FrequencyYears on the fixed-30/360 arm, which the reference oracle THROWS on ('Invalid repayment frequency', observed on the pinned oracle). This request is refusable for TWO reasons at once — the oracle cannot be asked at all (ErrUnsupportedConfiguration) and annual frequency is also outside the graded domain (ErrNoDiscriminatingVector) — so it is the vector that grades the contract's normative ERROR PRECEDENCE rule: strongest obstruction first, so both implementations must return ErrUnsupportedConfiguration. Without precedence, one implementation refusing as unsupported and the other as ungraded would be indistinguishable from a conformance failure.
